levels.surface: أبي جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر

notes: level 1 is the father (relation) with two co-transmitters, Muhammad b. al-Hasan and Muhammad b. Musa; the honorifics «رضي الله عنهم» and «عليهما السلام» are left out
«أبي جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر» is inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator (owner ruling 2)
